summary: A cloth that opens a two-way portal to another world (Barovia's mists won't let it open out of the valley).
text: Folded, this soft, silky black cloth is the size of a handkerchief; opened out, it is a round sheet 6 feet across. As a Magic action, spread it out on a solid surface and it opens a two-way gateway to some other world or plane, with the DM choosing the destination each time. A Magic action spent gripping its edges and folding it shuts the portal. After opening a portal, the Well can't open another for 1d8 hours.
